verdict.rationale: Oyster's pricing page says it can instantly generate contracts and send payments to freelance and short-term talent. It also claims multi-country payroll in 120+ currencies and compliant hiring in 120+ countries, so the core of the story is covered. All of this is marketing-level, and local-currency payout for contractors specifically is only implied by the payroll-currency claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation that contractor payments are paid in local currencies, detail on how contractor contracts are kept compliant (e.g., misclassification protection, country-specific templates), independent or hands-on corroboration of contractor payments.
